question: Who was the winner of 'The Hindu Prize 2019' in the category of Fiction?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Mirza Waheed__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mirza Waheed was the winner of 'The Hindu Prize 2019' in the category of Fiction.

 
 
• He is a novelist from Kashmir.
 
• His notable novels include:
 
 
• The Collaborator,
 
• The Book of Gold Leaves, and
 
• Tell her everything.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Hindu Prize

 
 
• It was instituted in 2010 to honour writers who have spent their lifetime mining the human spirit through their words and ideas.
 
• It is awarded at a ceremony during The Hindu's annual literature festival Lit for Life.
 
• In 2019, it has been awarded to Santanu Das for India Empire and First World War Culture( Non-fiction) and Mirza Waheed's Tell Her Everything( Fiction).
 
• In 2020, it was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
